title: Blocking a lost or stolen card
text: Customers can temporarily block a card in the app under Cards > Block. A temporary block can be undone at any time. For stolen cards, request a permanent block and replacement.

title: Annual fee schedule
text: The Classic card has no annual fee. The Gold card annual fee is 2,500 per year and is waived if annual spend exceeds 2,00,000.

title: Disputing a transaction
text: Customers should raise a dispute within 60 days of the statement date. Disputes are handled by the disputes team; the assistant must route these cases to a human agent.

title: Statement access
text: Monthly statements are available in the app under Accounts > Statements for the last 24 months.

title: Financial hardship
text: Customers who cannot make a payment should be offered a conversation with the hardship team. The assistant must not offer payment plans itself.

title: Reward points redemption
text: Reward points can be redeemed for statement credit or vouchers under Rewards. Points expire 36 months after they are earned.
